```{r main, echo=TRUE}
# =============================================================================
# V2 Pipeline — SparkR gapply Architecture (Databricks-native, no .tar shipping)
# Standard DBR cluster 0616-154127-izvo5r0w (NOT ML runtime)
# Outputs: /Volumes/projects/gwsc_drought/drought_outputs_v2/
# =============================================================================

CODES_PATH <- "/Workspace/Users/tajayalath@ua.edu/Drought-indices/files/Codes"
VOLUME_V2  <- "/Volumes/projects/gwsc_drought/drought_outputs_v2"

# -- Run flags (set FALSE to skip) -------------------------------------------
RUN_SPI         <- TRUE   # Script 01_v2 — spark_apply SPI
RUN_SPEI_T      <- FALSE  # Script 02a_v2 — spark_apply SPEI Thornthwaite
RUN_SPEI_P      <- FALSE  # Script 02b_v2 — spark_apply SPEI Penman
RUN_DETECTION   <- FALSE  # Script 03 — drought detection
RUN_FRIEDMAN    <- FALSE  # Script 06 — Friedman analysis
RUN_CROSSPERIOD <- FALSE  # Script 07 — cross-period analysis

# -- Step 1: SPI --------------------------------------------------------------
if (RUN_SPI) {
  message("STEP 1: SPI — spark_apply")
  VOLUME_PATH <- VOLUME_V2
  tryCatch(
    source(file.path(CODES_PATH, "01_v2_SPI_spark_apply.R")),
    error = function(e) {
      message("SCRIPT 01_v2 ERROR: ", conditionMessage(e))
      stop(e)
    }
  )
}

# -- Step 2a: SPEI Thornthwaite -----------------------------------------------
if (RUN_SPEI_T) {
  message("STEP 2a: SPEI Thornthwaite — spark_apply")
  VOLUME_PATH <- VOLUME_V2
  tryCatch(
    source(file.path(CODES_PATH, "02a_v2_SPEI_Thornthwaite_spark_apply.R")),
    error = function(e) {
      message("SCRIPT 02a_v2 ERROR: ", conditionMessage(e))
      stop(e)
    }
  )
}

# -- Step 2b: SPEI Penman -----------------------------------------------------
if (RUN_SPEI_P) {
  message("STEP 2b: SPEI Penman — spark_apply")
  VOLUME_PATH <- VOLUME_V2
  tryCatch(
    source(file.path(CODES_PATH, "02b_v2_SPEI_Penman_spark_apply.R")),
    error = function(e) {
      message("SCRIPT 02b_v2 ERROR: ", conditionMessage(e))
      stop(e)
    }
  )
}

# -- Step 3: Drought detection ------------------------------------------------
if (RUN_DETECTION) {
  message("STEP 3: Drought detection")
  VOLUME_PATH <- VOLUME_V2
  tryCatch(
    source(file.path(CODES_PATH, "03. Drought_Detection.R")),
    error = function(e) {
      message("SCRIPT 03 ERROR: ", conditionMessage(e))
      stop(e)
    }
  )
}

# -- Step 6: Friedman analysis ------------------------------------------------
if (RUN_FRIEDMAN) {
  message("STEP 6: Friedman analysis")
  VOLUME_PATH <- VOLUME_V2
  tryCatch(
    source(file.path(CODES_PATH, "06. Analysis1_Friedman.R")),
    error = function(e) {
      message("SCRIPT 06 ERROR: ", conditionMessage(e))
      stop(e)
    }
  )
}

# -- Step 7: Cross-period analysis --------------------------------------------
if (RUN_CROSSPERIOD) {
  message("STEP 7: Cross-period analysis")
  VOLUME_PATH <- VOLUME_V2
  tryCatch(
    source(file.path(CODES_PATH, "07. Analysis2_CrossPeriod.R")),
    error = function(e) {
      message("SCRIPT 07 ERROR: ", conditionMessage(e))
      stop(e)
    }
  )
}

message("V2 pipeline complete.")
```
